To get an LMIA-supported job offer, a the employer must prove they couldn't find a citizen to do the job, then advertise the role, hire you after extensive recruitment, and apply for the positive LMIA through Job Bank (Job Bank) and the [LMIA online portal (LMIA Online portal)](https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/foreign-workers/median-wage/low.html). Your role is to find an employer with a genuine need, possess the unique skills for the role, and apply with a strong profile, as this boosts your Express Entry CRS score (Express Entry CRS score). Key Takeaway A positive LMIA is a significant boost for your Express Entry profile, but it requires a dedicated, legitimate employer who has proven the need for a foreign worker. Be wary of scams; legitimate offers cannot be bought.

A few things that have helped others in our group: • Check your **local Gemeinde or Stadt website** — they often have event calendars for family activities, library story times, and seasonal meetups. • Search for **“Spielgruppe / Eltern-Kind Gruppe”** in your area on Facebook, there are usually small community groups organizing playdates and informal meetups. • Look up **city library (Stadtbibliothek) events** — many have regular story times or children’s programs. • Try apps like **Meetup** or **Nextdoor** — parents sometimes organize playdates or group outings there. • Some local **indoor playgrounds (e.g., Trampoline Parks, Kids Activity Centers)** have weekly parent mornings or classes, worth checking their schedules.
